subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle physics pipeline: mode-dispatch, time integration, suspension/spring-damper reset, contact-impulse accumulation, geometry proximity testing, wheel-force aggregation for sound/HUD, and yaw-recovery. Owns the vehicle physics state block (mode flag 0x32BC, rotation matrix 0x34B0..0x34D0, body position 0x34D4..0x34DC, wheel contact array 0x3668) plus several supporting math/matrix/sound objects that the same packet groups under the physics scope.

summary: A DERIVED architecture proposal for the vehicle_physics scope. The packet's 18 functions divide into one large vehicle physics state object (10 functions sharing the 0x32BC mode flag, 0x34B0 rotation matrix, 0x3668 wheel-contact array and body-position block) plus five smaller objects: a wheel angular-velocity integrator float state (0x004E43D0), a spatial-grid float update object (0x005000E0), a collision contact-state object (0x0054D7A0), a 4x4 matrix transform (0x0050D47D, 0x0052401F) and an engine-sound wave-table state (0x00513482). Owners are universally UNKNOWN; every function_roles owner and class boundary is DERIVED or GUESS. Key evidence-linked contracts: the physics processing mode enum at this+0x32BC (0/1/2 in 0x004E4930), the 50.265484 clamp-threshold dispatch (0x004E43D0), the integration sub-step selection (0x004E4E60), the contact-state low-bit encoding 1/2/4 (0x0054D7A0), and the wheel-contact surface contract (surface ids at +0x30/+0x34 behind entry pointer at +0x54). Several offsets are overloaded across the packet's own functions (0x32BC, 0x34B8, 0x3508) and are flagged as unresolved rather than resolved.

function_roles.role: Per-frame angular-velocity integrator over a float state vector; accumulates rotation, drives the velocity state toward a sign-selected bounded target with gain and convergence factor, and dispatches through InterruptDispatch when |this+0x24| exceeds the 50.265484 clamp threshold.
Routes vehicle physics processing by the mode flag at this+0x32BC: 0 full initialization, 1 sub-step integration, 2 team-color load, else no-op.

Vehicle physics time-integration driver: selects an integration sub-step size from wheel-speed squared, writes it to 4 wheel slots at this+0x35F0 (62-DWORD stride), then runs the sub-step count of suspension/tire physics chain iterations.

Per-frame suspension force initialization and damping-rate recomputation: zeroes per-wheel spring/damper accumulators, runs brake-cooling post-treatment when enabled, and re-selects/recomputes damping rates when the requested rate index changes.
Instance method that refreshes a 3x3 suspension transform matrix via F_3x3MatrixTransform and returns the result of an unresolved FieldReadDelegate tail helper.

Computes the distance from the predicted body position to the wheel-contact reference and writes a 13-element contact array into the network packet; returns the norm of the local contact vector clamped to the stored minimum.

Per-frame contact-impulse accumulation for a vehicle: transforms local contact basis and impulse through the rotation matrix, accumulates world-space linear and angular impulses, then dispatches on this+0x32BC (physics impulse / collision sparks / pointer-chain short-vector processing).
Per-frame physics timing step: clamps the accumulated time delta, then applies the global physics damping scale dbl_7C7428 unless the gate at this+0x32BC is set.

Vehicle geometry proximity/contact test: transforms a probe point into the vehicle-local frame, iterates up to four vehicle corners, and on a hit computes an anisotropic contact response with signed depth projection.
Aggregates wheel contact forces across the 4 wheels for a given surface type, grip-weighted, and stores the normalized result via PerIndexStructFieldSetter (index 2).
Aggregates wheel forces across the 4 wheels for a given surface type, speed-weighted by a clamped speed parameter, and stores the normalized result via PerIndexStructFieldSetter (index 1).
Per-frame vehicle sound/HUD trigger on the wheel-contact path: walks the wheel array, aggregates forces per unique surface, and drives HUD elements 5, 42 and 38 via HUDElementConfig.

Per-frame vehicle yaw-recovery controller: detects sustained excessive yaw rotation or loss of ground contact and restores the vehicle by resetting dynamics, rebuilding orientation, and re-anchoring to the racing line.
Conditionally updates a float field (a1[3], this+0xC) by adding a2 after validating the position vector with a spatial-grid query; returns 1 on update, 0 otherwise.
Initializes a 4x4 matrix at a1 to a diagonal form (a2/a3/a4 on the diagonal, 1.0 homogeneous), zeroing every other element.

Generates PCM wave tables for engine-sound synthesis: quality selector picks a multi-channel 16-bit table array or a 256-byte mono ramp table; samples converted with CRTFtol and normalized through read-only double constants.
Composes a 4x4 transformation matrix from a scale value, an optional rotation matrix (inverse/adjugate), an optional origin matrix and an optional additive translation, using 3DNow math.

Computes the distance between two collision feature offsets and classifies the contact state stored in the low bits of the state word at this+0x14 (1 potential, 2 separated, 4 contact); bit 0x10 selects a plane-based path.

classes.name: VehiclePhysicsState
classes.responsibility: Primary per-frame vehicle physics object. Owns the physics mode flag, rotation matrix, body/stored position, wheel contact array, contact-impulse accumulators, suspension damping-rate tables, and yaw-recovery state read and written by the packet's vehicle-physics functions.

classes.name: WheelAngularVelocityState
classes.responsibility: Per-frame float state vector integrated by WheelAngularVelocityIntegrator (rotation accumulation, sign-aware convergence of the velocity state toward a bounded target, clamp-threshold dispatch).

classes.name: SpatialGridFloatState
classes.responsibility: Small float state object whose scalar field is updated conditionally only after a spatial-grid validation of its position vector.

classes.name: CollisionContactState
classes.responsibility: Collision feature pair state used to classify contact: low bits of the state word encode 1=potential, 2=separated, 4=contact; bit 0x10 selects the plane-based classification path.

classes.name: Matrix4x4Transform
classes.responsibility: 4x4 row-major float matrix (element stride 4) initialized to a diagonal form by TransformInit and composed from scale/rotation/origin/translation by Matrix4x4TransformationConstructor.

classes.name: EngineSoundWaveTableState
classes.responsibility: Engine-sound synthesis table state: quality selector, mode words, quantization shift, per-entry pointer array and mono ramp table that EngineSoundWaveTableGenerator fills with normalized PCM samples.

classes.name: WheelContactEntry
classes.responsibility: Per-wheel contact entry in the wheel-contact array (stride 248 bytes / 62 dwords); its surface-struct pointer selects the surface type for force aggregation.

classes.name: WheelContactSurface
classes.responsibility: Contact surface-struct reachable at wheel entry +0x54; holds the force (0x30) and contact (0x34) surface-type identifiers used to deduplicate and select wheels for aggregation.

classes.name: VehiclePostProcessInput
classes.responsibility: Control/input object referenced through the postProcessInput pointer at vehicle this+0x0; holds the base-object field read for the mode-2 pointer chain and the control-mode flag (bit 8) gating yaw recovery.

state_machines.name: VehiclePhysicsProcessingMode
transitions: read this+0x32BC: 0 -> full_initialization, 1 -> substep_integration, 2 -> team_color_load, else noop
team_color_load stores input time at this+0x34AC and calls TeamColorLoader

state_machines.name: CollisionContactClassification
transitions: state low bits: 2 = separated, 1 = potential contact, 4 = contact
simple path: contact when innerRadius < v15 < outerRadius, else separated
plane path: distance beyond +threshold -> separated; within -threshold -> break to contact
bit 0x10 of state word selects the plane-based classification path

state_machines.name: HUDSoundWarningDrive
transitions: HUD element 5 (vibration) driven when velocity-delta magnitude exceeds 0
this+0x7A4 > 0 -> HUD element 42 (timer); else clear flag byte this+0x5FC
status 0: warning fires when dbl_7C9138 > dbl_7C9150; status 1: when this+0x39B8 > this+0x39C4 -> HUD element 38

interfaces.name: NetworkPacketDataWriter
interfaces.purpose: Writes network-packet fields; the wheel-contact path pushes 13 contact elements through it.

interfaces.name: HUDElementConfigurator
interfaces.purpose: Drives HUD element state by index (5 vibration, 42 timer, 38 warning) with an intensity/duration pair.

interfaces.name: PerIndexStructFieldSetter
interfaces.purpose: Stores per-surface-index aggregate fields; the two wheel-aggregation helpers write indices 2 (contact force) and 1 (speed-weighted force).

interfaces.name: SpatialGridQuery
interfaces.purpose: Validates a position vector against the spatial grid before a conditional float update.

interfaces.name: PhysicsImpulseSink
interfaces.purpose: Receives accumulated angular impulse and physics timing/damping updates keyed on the global physics object dbl_7C7428.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsProcessingModeDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: this+0x32BC selects vehicle physics processing: 0 runs full initialization (PitStateUpdateMachine, VehiclePhysicsIntegrationStep, VehicleSetupInitialization), 1 runs sub-step integration (PitStateUpdateMachine, PhysicsIntegrationStateMachine), 2 stores the input time at this+0x34AC and loads team colors; any other value is a no-op.

compatibility_contracts.name: AngularVelocityClampDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: When |this+0x24| exceeds the 50.265484 threshold (dbl_59ED28 / flt_5AD180), the accumulated value is passed to InterruptDispatch and written back to this+0x24.

compatibility_contracts.name: IntegrationSubstepSelection
compatibility_contracts.description: The integration sub-step size is selected by comparing wheel-speed squared (this+0x3508) with the threshold this+0x349C: small step this+0x34A0, or large step this+0x34A4 with an incremented count; the selected step is written to 4 wheel slots at this+0x35F0 (62-DWORD stride).

compatibility_contracts.name: ContactStateEncoding
compatibility_contracts.description: Contact state is encoded in the low bits of the state word at this+0x14: 1 potential contact, 2 separated, 4 contact. Bit 0x10 selects the plane-based classification path; otherwise an inner/outer radius test (this+0xF4/this+0xF8) decides.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelContactSurfaceContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Wheel contact entries at this+0x3668 (stride 248 bytes / 62 dwords) expose a surface-struct pointer at entry +0x54; the surface struct holds a force id at +0x30 and a contact id at +0x34. Aggregation helpers (0x004F0F40, 0x004F1120) select wheels whose surface id matches the requested surface type, weighted by grip/speed, and store results via PerIndexStructFieldSetter (indices 2 and 1).

compatibility_contracts.name: TimeDeltaDampingContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Each frame the accumulated time delta is clamped (AccumulatorClamp) and then scaled by the global physics damping source dbl_7C7428 unless the gate at this+0x32BC is set; the same global is used as the physics object for integration and angular-impulse accumulation.

unresolved: All 18 packet functions have UNKNOWN owners; no class boundary in this proposal is proven. VehiclePhysicsState is DERIVED from shared-field usage, and the five smaller classes (WheelAngularVelocityState, SpatialGridFloatState, CollisionContactState, EngineSoundWaveTableState, WheelContactEntry/WheelContactSurface/VehiclePostProcessInput) are GUESS groupings on equal base 'this' offsets that the packet itself cannot prove are the same objects.

this+0x32BC is overloaded across the packet's own functions: physics mode (0x004E4930), contact-processing mode (0x004EBC60), grip-factor gate (0x004F0F40), rigid-body status (0x004F12E0), yaw-rotation counter gate (0x004F1C40) and damping gate (0x004ED220). The packet gives no evidence that these are the same semantic field.

this+0x34B8 is read as a rotation-matrix element in 0x004EBC60 and as a yaw forward-axis component in 0x004F1C40, while existing analysis labels it elapsedTime [CONFIRMED]; the conflict is not resolvable from this packet.
this+0x3508 is read as wheel speed in 0x004E4E60 and as an angular-impulse accumulator component in 0x004EBC60; the interpretation depends on the vehicle-struct layout, which the packet does not pin.

WheelAngularVelocityIntegrator's wheel attribution and owner object type are DERIVED from the caller sub_4E5AE0's vehicle context, not independently confirmed; the physical meaning of this+0x30, this+0x54/0x58 and the 50.265484 threshold is undetermined.
The FieldReadDelegate tail in 0x004E9600 is not in the packet callee list; its identity and purpose are unresolved.

sub_4F1FE0's role beyond receiving the elapsed time is unverified; the constants folded into 0x004F1C40's comparisons (0.70710677, 5.0, 3.0) cannot be attributed to individual globals from the raw source.
In 0x005000E0, v9 is read before any visible assignment (likely a SpatialGridQuery output or compiler-eliminated callee result), and locals v5..v8 are initialized but never consumed.
The per-shift phase-step lookup dword_5D799C referenced by 0x00513482 is absent from the packet globals; sub_5881F0's role is not grounded.
The 4x4 matrix objects (a1) for 0x0050D47D and 0x0052401F have no callers recorded in the packet, so whether a2/a3/a4 are scale, translation or another diagonal interpretation is unknown.

The wheel-contact array layout (stride 62 dwords), the corner contact layout (stride 296, active byte at +64), and sub_4EA930's exact transform are reached only through relative-offset arithmetic and are DERIVED, not confirmed.

Seven read-only globals flagged by packet facts in each of 0x004F0F40, 0x004F1120, 0x004F12E0 and 0x004F1C40 appear nowhere in the raw decompiled source and are recorded in unresolved_evidence_refs rather than asserted as physics constants.
The contact response units, the 0.025 prediction scale (flt_59E87C) binding, and the NetworkPacketDataWriter 13-element wire layout are outside this packet's evidence.

Globals flagged not-in-raw for the aggregation/sound/recovery helpers (0x0059E478, 0x0059E600, 0x0059E7EC, 0x0059E800, 0x0059E824, 0x0059E84C, 0x0059E86C, 0x0059E8A0, 0x0059E8CC, 0x0059E9E4, 0x0059EC20, 0x005AC988, 0x005AD1C4, 0x005AD230, 0x005AD234, 0x005AD238) are listed in unresolved_evidence_refs.

The 'wheel/physics' prose labels (spring/damper accumulators, combined rate/inverse pairs, elapsedTime, timer/HUD element semantics) are inherited from the packet's existing-analysis layer and are DERIVED; they are not independently confirmed by raw source.
